description: The complete profile for one DJ: bio, pricing and whether the rate is negotiable, cancellation and travel terms, every service area, genres, occasions, extras offered, what they need from the venue, ratings, and THE ACTUAL BLOCKED DATES, not just a count, so you can answer whether a specific date is free. Takes the id or slug from search_djs. Call this for candidates worth a closer look; the search summary is enough to shortlist from.
